collection.title: Nissan Cabstar 1984 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Nissan Cabstar 1984 to 2012 model which requires a 18" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
